title: Measure hidden thinking output per merged PR and cut what does not pay
body:
Outcome: lead hidden (thinking) output tokens per merged PR are measured, and one lever (effort level per command, MAX_THINKING_TOKENS for lanes, or skill wording) lowers them without more turns or red Checks.
Why: lead-cost scan 2026-11-09 (session 3e700b2a): since 11-08 lead output 4.14M tokens, visible tool_use+text ~0.31M; ~3.8M hidden thinking ≈ $80 (~$1/PR); effortLevel is already medium.
Proof: a committed scan prints hidden output tokens per PR before and after the lever.
Scope: .claude/settings.json, .claude/agents, scripts.
